title: A repository
is a dataset.
beat.lede: 10 commits read straight out of git log, shaped into one journey document. The same beats, the same figure specs, and the same validator a research note goes through: only the reader changed.

title: Density is
the story.
beat.lede: Commits per week: the bursts, the quiet stretches, and the crunch before a landing, in the shape the histogram already knows how to show.

figure.caption: The same history read as rhythm rather than position. Volume is a consumption measure, so it stays monochrome.

title: Churn has
an address.
beat.lede: The same commits summed by top-level path, so a monorepo says which subsystem actually absorbed the work.

figure.caption: Where the work landed, by top-level path.

title: The hash is
the receipt.
beat.lede: Under every mark is an identifier that resolves to an exact tree. The visual is a way in, not a replacement for the record.

title: Any data,
